items.quote: Wir benötigen die Unterlagen spätestens am 7. Arbeitstag nach dem Briefdatum;
items.computation: Briefdatum (letter date) is Tuesday 30.09.2025. The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' as Monday to Friday excluding statutory public holidays, and counts 'nach dem Briefdatum' (after the letter date), so counting starts the day after, i.e. Wednesday 01.10.2025 = workday 1. Workday 2 = Thu 02.10.2025. Friday 03.10.2025 is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so it is skipped and not counted; Sat 04.10. and Sun 05.10. are also skipped as non-workdays. Workday 3 = Mon 06.10.2025, workday 4 = Tue 07.10.2025, workday 5 = Wed 08.10.2025, workday 6 = Thu 09.10.2025, workday 7 = Fri 10.10.2025. This 7th workday, 10.10.2025, is not itself a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letter states that if the documents are not submitted in time, only the already-documented positions will be reimbursed, which is a financial consequence the recipient should note but is not itself an objection deadline or payment demand.
